scenes.text: They blocked your air. And you're not opening that hatch.
A family you locked out is sitting on your only air vent.
So you dig a second one. In secret.
Sideways first. Away from them. Under the fence.
Slowly. Quietly. Every bucket of dirt goes back into the farm.
Then straight up, into the neighbor's yard.
You push a pipe through the last meter, and hide the top inside an old bush.
The bike powers a fan. And fresh air pours in.
Up top, they're still guarding your old vent. Waiting for you to give up.
Weird thing is, they never leave. Like they've got nowhere else to go.
And they still have no idea about your new vent.
But that night, a little voice comes down the new pipe.
Hello? Is someone down there? I'm so hungry.
The kid found your secret vent. What do you do? Top comment decides the final part.
